scope: same supplier, source-local vector manifests; not a universal drawing parser
tolerance_input: mixed searchable text and outlined CAD glyphs
field_truth: complete own-source tolerance cell and identity cells, independently reviewed
identity: source MODEL and ARTICLE in full, not filename or another product
title_font: standalone embedded TTF/OTF with all required glyphs; no TTC embedding
output_tolerance: dynamic sparse English footer, variable linear/angular/condition counts
source_color_policy: ordinary technical BLUE; emphasis only via reviewed source-color-role mapping; unknown REVIEW
unknown_field_or_layout: AI_LOCAL_REVIEW before new recipe; never silently inherit source coordinates or values
new_recipe_promotion: full-source gates plus output QA and user visual acceptance; negative samples never train
